0022600106.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (0-1, 13th in the East, 4th in the Central and 1 game back) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, 1st in the East and 1st in the Atlantic) for the Bucks' third game of the season. Milwaukee lost all four meetings with Philadelphia in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet this season. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while Dean Wade (ankle, sprain) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
